description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkAudioPlayer component, including test functions for playback scenarios and auxiliary functions for creating test audio data and handling timeouts.

classes.name: TimeoutError
classes.description: Custom error used to signal a timeout during asynchronous operations.

methods.description: Test ensuring that playback completes without hanging when the playback ends or fails.

methods.description: Test verifying that calling play twice does not cause the application to hang.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Utility function that runs an asynchronous work with a timeout to prevent hanging indefinitely.
